_comment: One row per school year, newest last. end_year is the calendar year the year ends in. last_day is the rollover: through that day a site shows this year's grade; from the next day it shows next year's (CLAUDE.md section 1, decided 2026-10-30). Add next year's row as soon as the school publishes its calendar; until then the embeds assume the year ends June 30 and say so in the console.
